results.text: Concept Node: Radical Disembodiment. Type: Degrading_Pattern. Description: AI severs the intellect from physical space and time, training students to believe rigor requires speaking from an objective, disembodied void rather than localized reality.

Concept Node: The Eradication of the Verb. Type: Degrading_Pattern. Description: AI substitutes the process (the verb: thinking, struggling, observing) with the product (the noun: the essay, the answer), treating education as a delivery mechanism for finished artifacts.

Concept Node: Temporal Flattening & Commodification. Type: Degrading_Pattern. Description: AI eradicates the natural incubation of thought (latency) and treats human interaction as a frictionless commodity. It replaces the visceral, time-bound weight of human care with instantaneous generation, accelerating the breakdown of digital relational reality.

Concept Node: Counterfeiting of Human Signals. Type: Degrading_Pattern. Description: AI aggressively commodifies and synthesizes the exact signals we use to prove humanity, forcing an arms race where digital authenticity is constantly being faked.
